alternatives.change_summary: Illustrative starter concept with schematic canopy, planting bed, water, path and built symbols.
Illustrative alternative that prioritizes a schematic water symbol and omits any assumption of modelled storage or runoff.

candidate_sources.limitation: Not a species inventory, planting suitability result, or site survey.
Priority-area designation does not establish parcel-level habitat condition or species presence.
Daily 0.05-degree rainfall is not a local event hyetograph or calibrated runoff input.
A 30 m surface model is not a surveyed site grade or small-drainage network.
Community mapping may be incomplete and does not establish route accessibility compliance.
Multispectral imagery is not an individual-tree crown inventory or field species observation.
Exact sheet/product, date, CRS, accuracy and reuse terms must be verified before ingestion.

metric_assessments.reason: No georeferenced location, qualified obstacle geometry, or validated shadow method is available in the schematic project.
missing_inputs: Date, local time, time zone and solar position
Validated shadow model and independent reference

metric_assessments.reason: The candidate-source catalog is metadata-only and contains no calibrated catchment, soil, drainage, or event rainfall inputs.
missing_inputs: Local event hyetograph or qualified design storm
Calibrated model and independent discharge/volume reference

metric_assessments.reason: Schematic planting symbols do not identify botanical species; biodiversity-priority maps are not a species inventory.
The rendered path glyph is not a path centerline and the drawing has no validated elevation profile.
The symbols are not a quantity take-off and no local cost or lifecycle schedule is attached.

ranking_reasons: All consequence-bearing metric assessments are blocked because the project is schematic and candidate data are not ingested.
No Symtropy analytical simulation is qualified for this coordinate frame.
No baseline or alternative has independent observed outcome evidence.

pairwise_tradeoffs.summary: Whether the canopy-first or water-first design better balances thermal comfort and water demand is unknown until location, canopy geometry, climate and qualified models are available.
Species suitability, establishment, irrigation and maintenance obligations are not specified or verified; no ecological or lifecycle preference is justified.

recommendation.rationale: Do not choose a winner from schematic drawings. Preserve alternatives, obtain the missing validated inputs, then rerun the review against exact pinned project and scenario digests.
tradeoffs: Potential shade benefits versus water demand are unresolved.
Potential habitat/connectivity benefits versus maintenance burden are unresolved.
Access, lifecycle cost and community priorities have not been qualified.
recommendation.next_step: Select a lawful data acquisition path, survey the pilot site as needed, verify source license/CRS/quality, and define a preregistered field evaluation before claiming impacts.

falsification_questions: Does independent site mapping or survey contradict the assumed location, elevations, obstacles, or drainage context?
Do measured outcomes under a declared baseline contradict the direction or magnitude of any proposed benefit?
Does source-license or consent review forbid the planned ingestion, caching, publication, or site-level disclosure?
limitations: This is a schema/conformance fixture only; its digest values and project/authority references are sentinel placeholders and do not identify real source artifacts.
All geometry is schematic symbol anchors in arbitrary local drawing units, not surveyed geometry or engineering-ready shapes.
Candidate source references are not ingested or qualified inputs; the fixture contains no measured environmental or social outcome.
No universal sustainability score, selected winner, construction decision, public-safety certification, or actuator instruction is emitted.

replay.environment_note: Sentinel digest values in this fixture are placeholders; no runtime model calculation was performed.
